command: set -euo pipefail; S=frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service; D=$HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final/scripts; BEFORE=$(systemctl --user show $S -p MainPID --value); STATE=$(systemctl --user show $S -p ActiveState --value); echo BEFORE_PID=$BEFORE; echo BEFORE_STATE=$STATE; test "$BEFORE" = 0; test "$STATE" = inactive; systemctl --user start $S; sleep 4; PID=$(systemctl --user show $S -p MainPID --value); ACTIVE=$(systemctl --user show $S -p ActiveState --value); SUB=$(systemctl --user show $S -p SubState --value); echo AFTER_PID=$PID; echo AFTER_STATE=$ACTIVE/$SUB; test "$PID" -gt 0; test "$ACTIVE" = active; test "$SUB" = running; COUNT=$(pgrep -af '/home/ai-core-node/.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final/scripts/voice_final_runtime.py' | grep -v 'local_bridge_daemon.py' | wc -l); echo FINAL_RUNTIME_PROCESS_COUNT=$COUNT; test "$COUNT" -eq 1; sha256sum "$D/voice_final_runtime.py" "$D/omega_runtime.py" "$D/omega_world_turn.py" "$D/omega_cognitive_regulation.py" "$D/omega_externalized_cognition.py" "$D/omega_externalized_learning.py"; systemctl --user show $S -p ExecStart -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID --no-pager; journalctl --user -u $S --since '-20 seconds' --no-pager -o short-iso | tail -80; echo FRED_PR133_FINAL_START_AT_PROVEN_IDLE_PASS
